name: PRERANA Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
provider: ST & SC Development Department, Government of Odisha
summary: Odisha's post-matric portal scholarship for SC/ST students from Class XI onwards, covering admission fees, tuition and maintenance allowance.

benefit.details: Maintenance allowance (hosteller/day scholar) plus compulsory fee reimbursement via DBT.

special_conditions: Institution must be on the PRERANA empanelled list

steps: Select PRERANA SC/ST scheme and fill academic details
Complete institute verification and track status

notes: CLOSED on 29 September 2026 on the Odisha State Scholarship Portal. The previous entry showed 31 December, which was never published. The Pre-Matric (Class IX–X) window ran slightly longer, to 9 October 2026. Bidesh Sikhyabruti closed earlier still, on 18 September 2026.

name: PRERANA Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC / SEBC / EBC Students
provider: ST & SC Development Department, Government of Odisha
summary: Post-matric support for OBC/SEBC students and Economically Backward (General) students of Odisha studying Class XI and above.

benefit.details: Course-wise maintenance allowance credited by DBT after verification.

special_conditions: OBC/SEBC certificate of Odisha, or EWS/EBC income certificate for General-category applicants
Income cap has shifted between cycles — re-verify current order

documents: OBC/SEBC caste certificate or EBC declaration
notes: CLOSED on 29 September 2026, same window as the SC/ST post-matric component.

name: Nua-O Scholarship (Odisha)
provider: Higher Education Department, Government of Odisha
summary: New-age scholarship for UG/PG students of Odisha government and government-aided colleges & universities, launched to cut dropouts after +2.

benefit.details: Annual amount over the course duration, DBT-credited after college verification.

special_conditions: Student of a government/government-aided college, university or SAMS-covered institution
Students already drawing a state/central scholarship for the same component are excluded
Income bar, where notified, applies — check the current guidelines

steps: Select Nua-O and confirm college details

notes: No 2026–27 notification located in this review pass; the 2027-02-28 date is carried forward and unverified.

name: Chief Minister's Medhabruti Scholarship (Odisha)
provider: Higher Education Department, Government of Odisha
summary: Merit scholarship for bright Odisha students in UG/PG and technical & professional courses through the e-Medhabruti portal.

benefit.details: Annual stipend for the programme duration subject to renewal merit.

special_conditions: Merit lists prepared from qualifying-exam marks (55–60% bands)
Technical/professional streams have separate Medhabruti lines
Family income up to ₹8,00,000 and minimum 55% in the last examination (per the Odisha portal listing)

steps: Choose Medhabruti and enter qualifying marks
Merit list publication → institute verification → DBT

notes: e-Medhabruti (Technical & Professional, and PG Merit) is listed by the Odisha portal as 'to be announced' for 2026–27, so the 2026-12-31 date shown here is carried forward from the previous cycle and is NOT confirmed. Known criteria from the same listing: family income up to ₹8,00,000 and at least 55% in the last examination. Watch scholarship.odisha.gov.in for the notification.

name: Banishree Scholarship (Students with Special Needs, Odisha)
provider: Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Dept., Government of Odisha
summary: Scholarship and reader/transport allowances for students with benchmark disability from middle school up to postgraduate study in Odisha.

benefit.details: Base scholarship phased by class, with additional allowances for readers and commuting.

special_conditions: Benchmark disability (40%+) with Odisha UDID/disability ID

steps: Collect the Banishree form (online or district office)
Submit through school/college or DSSO office

notes: Was recorded as 'rolling'; it is an annual window closing 30 November 2026. Administered through the Odisha State Scholarship Portal for students with disabilities.

name: KALIA Scholarship (Children of KALIA Beneficiary Farmers, Odisha)
provider: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment, Government of Odisha
summary: Full course-fee support for children of KALIA-listed farmers taking admission in government professional/technical courses — agriculture-linked families study free in government colleges.

benefit.amount_display: Actual course fees in government colleges (Nursing, Polytechnic, ITI, Agri, etc.)
benefit.details: Tuition/annual course fee paid to the institution for eligible KALIA farmer households.

special_conditions: Parent must be an approved KALIA beneficiary on the Krushak Odisha list
Merit-based admission in a government institution (fee support in government colleges)
Only one child per family per cycle

documents: KALIA beneficiary ID of the parent (Krushak Odisha)
Admission & fee receipt of a government institution
Bank + Aadhaar details of the student

application.portal: Agri Extension Portal / District Agriculture Office
steps: Verify the parent's KALIA beneficiary status
Apply via the district agriculture office / portal with admission proof
Fee support paid to the institution

notes: No 2026–27 notification located in this review pass. The KALIA scheme's continuation and its scholarship component should be confirmed on kalia.odisha.gov.in before relying on the 'rolling' designation.
